title: packet-scylla.c: dissect protocol feature negotiation
description:
This patch adds more detailed dissection to the protocol negotiation phase.
It dissects the various features that are negotiated as part of the negotiation.
In the future, those should be saved and used as part of the conversation.

In addition, it updates the list of verbs.

Signed-off-by: Yaniv Kaul <yaniv.kaul@scylladb.com>
